create_ovis2_image_processor: create an Ovis2ImageProcessor instance with custom patch and resize settings for multimodal image processing
build_image_crop_to_patches: build image patches from a tensor using covering area grid or optimal aspect ratio tiling
test_crop_image_to_patches: test cropping images into patches with configurable min/max patches and covering threshold
run_image_preprocess: run preprocessing on input images including resize, crop, rescale, normalize, and patch splitting
get_optimal_tiled_canvas: get optimal tile grid dimensions that match the original image aspect ratio within supported tile counts
